principle: Metrics propose candidate groupings and candidate extractor families; only inner chronological validation under equal budgets decides, and nothing is fitted on outer validation or the external test.

populations.outer_train: declared TRAIN rows of the admissible-input declaration
populations.inner_folds: K=3 expanding-window chronological folds inside outer_train; each inner validation block is the last 15% of its fold; purge gap = lookback + max horizon rows between inner train and inner validation
populations.outer_validation: used once, to compare frozen candidates chosen on inner folds (M04 incumbent rule)
populations.external_test: NEVER used for any selection, grouping, importance, threshold or cluster count

stages.name: admissibility
stages.rule: take the admissible-input declaration as is; exclusions keep their reasons; no extra drop

stages.name: singleton baseline
stages.rule: one feature per branch (declaration branches_one_feature_each); this is candidate G0

stages.name: all-admissible control
stages.rule: every admissible feature in one shared-input branch arrangement with the same core/head budget; candidate C_ALL; always reported beside every grouped candidate

stages.name: domain groups
stages.rule: groups declared from column semantics before seeing any target (e.g. weather: pressure/temperature/humidity/wind/radiation/rain; FX: trend/oscillator/volatility/calendar); a dataset without declared semantics (Electricity, Traffic client IDs) records G1 as UNSUPPORTED_NO_DOMAIN_SEMANTICS, not as a result

stages.name: metric-space clusters
stages.rule: standardize the TRAIN-only profile vectors (per column: acf lags, declared-seasonality ACF and STL strength, spectral entropy and peak period, diff_std_over_std, tail ratios, ADF/KPSS statistics) using statistics of the inner-train fold only; agglomerative Ward clustering; number of clusters k in {2,3,4,6,8} (bounded by branch count) chosen by inner-validation loss, not by silhouette alone

stages.name: redundancy / lag-informed groups
stages.rule: on each inner-train fold: |Pearson| >= t with t in {0.90, 0.95, 0.99} forms connected components; lagged max |cross-correlation| over lags 1..primary period merges leader->follower pairs above the same t; threshold t chosen by inner-validation loss

stages.name: extractor proposal
stages.rule: metrics only PROPOSE branch extractor families to include in the search: strong declared-seasonality (STL seasonal strength >= 0.6 or seasonal ACF >= 0.5) proposes dilated causal Conv1D with receptive field >= the period; persistent low-frequency or unit-root reading proposes differenced input or recurrent branch; heavy tails (tail ratio > 2x Gaussian) propose robust scaling; every proposal is tested against the default causal Conv1D under the same budget and can lose

stages.name: freeze
stages.rule: the grouping, k or t, and extractor families with the best mean inner-validation loss (ties -> fewer parameters) are frozen with their digests BEFORE outer validation is read

comparison.metric: the forecasting objective declared by M04 (MSE/MAE in the protocol's TRAIN-fitted scaled space) plus same-row persistence skill
comparison.budget: equal candidate budget (epochs, early-stopping patience, parameter count within +-10%) across G0, C_ALL, G1, G2, G3
comparison.report: every candidate, including losers, with inner fold losses; exclusions and their reasons carried from S0

forbidden: target-based selection on the external test
fitting scalers, clusters, thresholds or importances on any non-inner-train rows
claiming a metric proves an architecture wins
